hooks.name: Keep scenario SHAs stable
hooks.description: Remind to keep planted scenario commit SHAs stable after a service file changes

action.prompt: A file under services/ was saved. The scenario branches are built on top of main by scripts/plant-scenarios.mjs, so any change to main changes what the planted commits patch. Re-run the plant script test (pnpm --filter @haunted-lab/supervisor exec vitest run test/plant.test.ts). If a runtime file changed on purpose and the SHAs moved, update EXPECTED in supervisor/test/plant.test.ts (and the scenario patches in scripts/lab-git.mjs if the patched code changed), and say so in the task notes.
